decisions.decision: Put the webview opt-out in `lucy webview serve` behind LUCY_NO_WEBVIEW, not in case.md
decisions.rationale: case.md is byte-frozen with a committed SHA-256 guard and its launch block explicitly forbids extra arguments. An environment variable is the only switch that reaches through the frozen call; a CLI flag would not. case.md stayed byte-unchanged, confirmed via git.
A host setting LUCY_NO_WEBVIEW=0 to mean 'keep the dashboard' must never silently lose it. Guarded by a dedicated parametrised test.
Doing nothing needs no dependency, so a disabled run also succeeds on a host without the [webview] extra.

decisions.decision: Leave the post-run webview running for interactive CASE runs
decisions.rationale: case.md line 945 leaves it up deliberately (WV-07) so a run can be reviewed afterwards. That is correct for interactive use; only headless benchmark runs are leakage. The opt-out targets exactly those.

decisions.decision: Record the benchmark's mixed provenance as an accepted decision, not an open defect
decisions.rationale: The user decided in discussion to keep runs spanning two skill states AND two team models (4.8 -> Opus 5) rather than re-run: a clean series costs far too much time and quota, and the measured effect is large enough that it would only gain precision. A pending-todo framing was wrong and was deleted.

decisions.decision: Refresh the frozen agent-file hashes rather than revert d62d833
decisions.rationale: The edit (heteroatom protons need their own HSQC declaration or LSD aborts) is deliberate and verified against the solver's own check. case.md and the other three agent files still matched byte for byte, so the drift was fully explained. Guard re-verified by mutation: one extra byte makes it fail. User approved 2026-08-27.

decisions.decision: Weekly quota ceiling now 30 %, in three steps over six days
decisions.rationale: The user's interactive Claude use keeps growing and the week has to last for them. Trigger for the last step: 21 % of the weekly window gone twelve hours after the reset. Accepted consequence: the benchmark is blocked for much of each week.

decisions.decision: Keep the compute host's checkout in sync from now on
decisions.rationale: It sat at 2026-08-13 for three weeks, so the webview opt-out shipped on 08-27 never took effect there and servers kept leaking. Verified before pulling that .claude/ was unchanged across those commits, so the running campaign did NOT gain a third skill state.
